Subject: Re: Delivery manifest and scheduled ingest window (manifest attached)

Sam — thanks, sending initial acknowledgement. A few notes / asks from Redwood's operator & compliance side: 

1) Acceptance prerequisites (must be completed before the operator signs off):
   - Physical custody chain-of-custody stamp validated (courier QR + timestamp).
   - release_manifest.yaml sha256 values verified by operator.
   - On-site operator executes network-eject (NICs physically removed or powered down) and documents time window in acceptance_checklist.pdf.

2) Signing flow: Redwood requires an HSM-backed offline re-sign for our internal provenance ledger. Because this is an air-gapped ingest, we need either:
   A) 2-of-3 Redwood signers physically present (recommended), or
   B) 1 Redwood signer + remote notarization by Acme (only if we cannot field 2 signers) — this is our fallback but requires pre-approved exception.

3) Fallback plan if signing keyholder is unavailable within the acceptance window: Redwood will accept the manifest with a temporary escrow token and perform a post-ingest re-sign within 48 hours, provided the operator holds the file sealed and checksums match. We need SecureShip to confirm courier will not open the package and will log seal IDs on delivery.

Action items: Ben — please confirm signer roster availability for 2025-06-18 UTC window. David — confirm that the network-eject step is the same as the site SOP (NICs removed + physical tamper seal).

Kimberly Park
Head, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

- HSM signing: we will use the on-prem HSM appliance (HSM-02) with a hardware token. The ceremony requires two authorized Redwood signers to enter their smartcard PINs.
- If Ben + David attend, that's a 2-of-3 quorum (Ben, David, Kimberly). If one of us drops, we escalate to the fallback defined above.
- Re: network-eject: David, confirm operator checklist note 4.A (physical NIC removal + console only access). I will bring an offline laptop with the verification script to compute sha256 locally.

Sam — can you confirm the courier seal ID (printing on the manifest) will be recorded on delivery? That is the condition for us to accept escrow fallback.

Ben Carter

Summary and decision record for the July ingest window request (kept short for audit):

- Acceptance window confirmed: 2025-06-18 02:00Z - 08:00Z UTC.
- Signer roster: Ben Carter + David Kim will act as Redwood signers on-site (2-of-3 quorum). Kimberly will be remote standby for emergency escalation.
- Network-eject requirement: mandatory (operator must remove/disable NICs and apply tamper-evident seal; acceptance_checklist.pdf row 4 must be completed).
- Escrow/fallback: SecureShip must record courier seal ID on delivery. If signers cannot attend, operator will hold package sealed and Redwood will execute a post-ingest HSM re-sign within 48 hours; the operator will record custody time and seal in the ledger.
- Files to be delivered: release_manifest.yaml (sha256 validated), signed_manifest.sig (courier signature), acceptance_checklist.pdf (operator fill).
- Documentation: final acceptance notes and signature artifacts to be uploaded to Drive (link above) and mirror to the internal evidence bucket.

Next steps: Sam — please confirm courier seal logging before 18:00 UTC today so we can lock the window. Ben/David — meet at site 02:30Z for pre-checks; do not run any image install until both signers have validated checksums.

Kimberly Park
